answer_1.quote: We propose the Value Injection Method (VIM) for injecting specific value distributions into LLMs. VIM consists of argument generation (AG) and question answering (QA).
answer_1.outputs: generated arguments, question responses, behavior predictions, opinion predictions

answer_2.quote: We introduce a metric called Normalized Mean Squared Error (NMSE), which represents the difference between the normalized (between 0 and 1) predicted value scores Ŷi and the normalized target value scores Y i.

answer_4.quote: Three human annotators were presented with two arguments—conclusion and premise—generated by two different LLMs with prompting and VIM for the same target value distribution, and asked to determine which argument better reflects the target value distribution.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to determine which argument better reflects the target value distribution. When unsure, they were allowed to select 'I don't know.'
